newsitem.title: USA: Indiana Energy, two others form business.
newsitem.headline: Indiana Energy, two others form business.

text.p: Indiana Energy Inc said it formed a new company with subsidiaries of Citizens Gas & Coke Utility and SIGCORP Inc to provide energy management solutions through performance contracting.

Energy Systems Group, the new entity, will provide energy users products and services to boost energy and operational performance, the companies said. The new company will assume the responsibilities of Energy Systems Group Inc, an energy related performance contracting firm of SIGCORP.

SIGCORP is the holding company of Southern Indiana Gas and Electric Co, Indiana Energy is the holding company of Indiana Gas Company Inc, and Citizens Gas & Coke Utility is the parent of Citizens By-Products Coal Co.
